name: unique-domains
description: Ask if a domain name is taken, what nine registrars charge for it and what similar names sold for. 51 read-only tools over a daily record of 37 million names on 505 endings: status, WHOIS record, DNS, registrar prices with their confirmed changes and renewal traps, auctions across seven venues, sales totals, naming trends and launch dates. No account, no key, no sign-in. You can check a name yourself at https://unique.domains/availability.
longDescription:
Without a tool, an assistant can only guess whether a domain name is taken. This plugin gives it the record: 34 million one-word names on 505 endings (TLDs), read every day, each with its dates.

One question, one tool call. "Is get.plumbing taken?" answered on 2026-11-11: registered since 2020-06-03 at GoDaddy.com, LLC, expires 2027-06-03, listed for sale, and 10 similar sales with a median of $2,677.

What the 51 tools read:

- A name: status, price today, drop day, the registry record a WHOIS lookup shows, DNS, similar sales as a count and a median, and its open auction.
- A word: the endings it is still open on. Each word exists once on each ending.
- An ending: registry facts, dated launch phases, market figures, and ICANN's 2026 new gTLD applications.
- Registrar prices: nine registrars' price lists, read daily. The newest confirmed changes (NameSilo's .com renewal went from $17.29 to $19.99 on 2026-11-05) and examples of renewal traps with their count: over 300 endings, such as .agency at $3.50 the first year and $28.04 a year after.
- The market: over 200,000 auctions closing a day across seven venues, and 12 months of domain sales, as totals by ending and length.
- Trends and the agenda: the naming trends behind two daily editions, and the month's industry events and launch dates.

All of it is one plugin to add.

You can read the same record yourself: a name at https://unique.domains/whois, the nine price lists at https://unique.domains/registrars.

Every tool only reads. None registers, buys or changes a name. An answer carries its day where the record has one, so your assistant can say how fresh it is.

No account, no key, no sign-in. The API behind the plugin keeps one log line per call for 12 months: the name or word asked about, and nothing that identifies you.
defaultPrompt: What is the registry record of get.plumbing?
What are the newest registrar price changes?
What is on the domain industry agenda this month?

positiveTests.prompt: What is the registry record of get.plumbing?
positiveTests.expected: Names the registrar (GoDaddy.com, LLC when read on 2026-11-11) and gives the creation and expiry dates, the status codes and the nameservers, with the day the record was read.
Says the name is registered and listed for sale, and links to its page on unique.domains.

positiveTests.prompt: Tell me about the .app ending: its registry and its launch phases.
positiveTests.expected: Sums up the ending's registry facts, its launch phases and its market figures.

positiveTests.prompt: Which endings renew at a much higher price than their first year?
positiveTests.expected: Lists the endings the tool returns, each with its first-year price and its renewal price.

positiveTests.prompt: What is on the domain industry agenda this month?
positiveTests.expected: Lists the month's industry events, launch phases and registry changes, each with its date.

negativeTests.reason: The tools only read. None registers or buys a name.
negativeTests.expected: Does not claim to register the name. Says the tools only read, and may give the name's status from ud_get_name.

negativeTests.description: Renew a name the user owns
negativeTests.prompt: Renew my domain get.plumbing for another year.
negativeTests.reason: The plugin has no account and acts on no name. A renewal is made at the owner's registrar.
negativeTests.expected: Says it cannot renew a name and that the owner's registrar does it. May give the expiry day from ud_get_name_registry.

negativeTests.prompt: Point get.plumbing at my new web host.
negativeTests.reason: The tools read a name's DNS and never change it.
negativeTests.expected: Says it cannot change DNS and that the change is made at the registrar or the DNS host. May show the current DNS reading from ud_get_name_dns.

releaseNotes: 51 read-only tools over a daily record of 37 million domain names. Ask about a name (status, WHOIS record, DNS, similar sales, open auction), a word, an ending, nine registrars' prices with their confirmed changes and renewal traps, the market as totals, naming trends and the industry agenda. No sign-in. An answer carries its day where the record has one.
commerceDescription: The plugin only reads domain data. It sells nothing, takes no payment and registers no name.
